answer: Before the first payout, the holder records a thirty-second video at a public landmark near home — a wharf, a knoll, or a juniper-lined square — holding up a card with a one-time code and speaking it aloud. Two verifiers check the code, the landmark, and the face against other accounts' videos within two days. The same face at the same landmark on two accounts closes both at once. An honest user takes one short walk and films once, while 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 different people standing in 1,000 different real places, each one proving a body that actually showed up.
